about.text: In this expedited election case, relator, David Spencer, asks for a writ of prohibition to prevent respondents, the Stark County Board of Elections and its members, Dimitrios Pousoulides, Janet Weir Creighton, R. Shane Jackson, and James F. Mathews (collectively, “the Stark County board”), from placing respondent Jullie Kelley on the May 5, 2026 primary-election ballot as a candidate for the Republican Party nomination for the office of U.S. Representative for the Sixth Ohio Congressional District.

caseName: State ex rel. Spencer v. Stark Cty. Bd. of Elections
